description: Find companies on LinkedIn by keyword, optionally in one location: 10 companies with name, industry, location, follower count, summary and LinkedIn link. Use it when: You are building a list of companies in a market or region, for lead generation, partners or competitors. Not for: Full company details (use the LinkedIn company profile node on a result) or people at those companies. Returns: 10 companies: name, industry, location, follower count, short summary and LinkedIn link. Typical time: about 4 s. Price: $0.030 per search (up to 10 companies), charged only on success. One call = up to 10 companies.

location.description: Optional city, region or country, e.g. Germany or Austin

query.description: What the companies do or are called, e.g. solar installer, fintech, coffee roastery

name: linkedin-company-search
title: LinkedIn company search
